title: MusicDrop v1.3.9 Available
changelog:
• Edge-to-Edge Video: Full immersive edge-to-edge video mode with expandable bottom controls
• Video Sizing Options: Switch dynamically between 16:9 Fit, Fill Zoom (Crop), and Wide Stretch
• Collapsible Music Controls: Collapse player controls while watching video to maximize video screen size
• Sleek Floating Player Pill: Floating frosted glass bar with mini progress scrubber, quick controls, and one-tap restore
• Native ExoPlayer Hardware Acceleration & Fixed Video Playback
